notes.title: Discord Invitation and a Quick News Update for Chapter 3
notes.content:
[h2]Join our Discord![/h2]
Whether you're stuck on a puzzle or getting stopped by Aya, our community will be ready to help!
Or if you have your own playthrough and would like to share, our Discord is open!
Or you just want to keep up to date with us and talk with other players, you're all welcome!
Also, we're still improving chapter 3 after the recent early access, look forward to it.
There are a lot of grounds to cover and we're doing our best.

notes.title: We Need Your Help to Improve the Game More
notes.content:
Good day everyone!
It's been a week since chapter 2 came out, how was it?
Hopefully, you are having fun and taking your time playing it! We worked hard for this one.

[h2]We need your help![/h2]
If you have finished chapter 2 and would like to help us to improve the game, you can fill in this survey: https://bit.ly/OOFTCH2S
It's only a 1-minute survey, although you can also fill in more details to help us more.
Or, you can also review the game on Steam or comment your opinions in the comment down below.

To report any bugs you find or ask questions, you're welcome to join [url=https://discord.gg/NTCq2fY]Dragon Emperors Discord Server[/url].

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Are You Ready to be the First to Explore the Temple?
notes.content:
Good day everyone!

Thank you for waiting patiently for chapter 2. It can now be played and we'd like some of your impressions first!

[h3][b]Back up your save data before doing this! (By right-clicking Oracle in your steam library, on manage, click local files. Copy all the save01-save04 to the desktop or any other safe place.)[/b][/h3]
Chapter 2 can now be accessed by opting in on the beta section. You can access this by right-clicking Oracle in your Steam library and then clicking on the properties.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32011136/9de90087ca35124ae0674edbcac6ed43f4df2645.png[/img]
Putting in the code [b][i]chapter2beta[/i][/b] and clicking '[b]check code[/b]' will give you a new option on the dropdown list called [b]ch2cbt[/b]. Clicking ch2cbt and closing the window should start the download for the beta after a bit. In the game, chapter 2 can be accessed by loading the 4th save.

Please fill out this form after trying out the beta: [url=https://bit.ly/OOFTCH2]Oracle of Forgotten Testament Closed Beta Test Survey[/url]
To report any bugs you find or ask any question you have, you're welcome to join [url=https://discord.gg/NTCq2fY]Dragon Emperors Discord Server[/url].
If you'd like your friend to join you in trying out the newest chapter, they can do so by registering through [url=bit.ly/OOFTCBT]this form[/url]. They will also be able to access chapter 1 so they won't miss out on anything.

If you are interested, we will be waiting for you on our Discord server.
Stay tuned!
------------------------------

notes.title: Chapter 2 beta is on the way!
notes.content:
Good day everyone!

Thank you for waiting patiently for chapter 2. The development is nearing its end and we would like your help to test the game out!

In the first half of September, you should be able to try out chapter 2 from start to finish; explore the temple; defeat enemies; defeat every boss available.
What we would want from you is to check out the difficulty of the puzzles, the enemies, and the bosses of chapter 2, and compare it to chapter 1.

You also might want to join [url=https://discord.gg/NTCq2fY]Dragon Emperors Discord Server[/url] to give any bug reports and to give your feedback to us. Any further updates about the beta test will be announced there too.
If you'd like your friend to join you in trying out the newest chapter, they can do so by registering through [url=bit.ly/OOFTCBT]this form[/url]. They will also be able to access chapter 1 so they won't miss out on anything.

[h3]Remember, the first half of September![/h3]
If there's any change to the date, we will surely keep you updated.

If you are interested, we will be waiting for you on our Discord server.
Stay tuned!

P.S.: If you think you're feeling deja vu or seeing double, this is a new announcement with a better approximate date.

notes.title: Lunar New Year 2020 Update
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year 2020
Hope you're all in good health

The demo for the new chapter of Oracle of Forgotten Testament is now live!

Play as the strongest fairy in Gensokyo, and take a peek at the exciting new stories and battle mechanics introduced in chapter 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32011136/bfdb679bce31f5aa455a56c7051a75da92ef9347.png[/img]

But before, everyone who already bought the game couldn't access the new content. Now, we've integrated the demo inside the game so all of you can try out the demo. Hopefully, the full chapter will be out soon enough.

The Lunar New Year Sale is also live!
Grab the game for 20% off for the duration of the sale!

You can check the demo in the store page, or at the Dragon Emperors website below.
https://dragonemperors.com

Have a nice day!
